title: v2 offline ML experiments - pre-registered protocol
written: 2026-10-26, before any v2 data was downloaded or any v2 model was fitted

scope.application: UK wind purchasing decisions made 1-31 January 2026 (delivery 2 Jan - 1 Feb 2026). These experiments do not change it.
scope.development_data: decisions 2024-10-01 .. 2025-12-31: all data published before the first January cutoff
scope.january_2026: context only - it has been evaluated before and is never used to choose
scope.february_2026: not used - it already influenced the current production defaults
scope.supplementary_evaluation: decisions 2026-03-01 .. 2026-05-31; its data is downloaded only after this protocol is locked, and it is evaluated once

decision_rule: forecast_mw = latest WINDFOR value published at or before 09:50 Europe/London on D-1; every feature uses only data published by that cutoff

targets.regression: error_mw = forecast_mw - actual_mw (actual = FUELHH half-hour starting at the forecast hour, as in production); corrected forecast = forecast_mw - predicted error

feature_sets.curve: spline(forecast_mw: 5 quantile knots, degree 3, linear extrapolation) + hour_sin + hour_cos
feature_sets.all: curve + existing9 without lead_hours (identical to hour_uk because every decision uses the 09:30 run) + err_last3h_mw, err_prev_day_mw, err_7d_mw, err_band_14d_mw, forecast_revision_24h_mw, forecast_day_max_mw, forecast_day_min_mw, forecast_day_std_mw, day_of_week, bank_holiday, ndfd_demand_mw, wind_share_ndfd

new_features.hour_sin, hour_cos: UK clock hour on a circle
new_features.err_last3h_mw: mean day-ahead error of the 3 most recent hours whose actual was published by the cutoff
new_features.err_prev_day_mw: mean day-ahead error over UK day D-2 (requires >= 20 known hours)
new_features.err_7d_mw: mean day-ahead error over the hours of the 7 days before the cutoff whose actual was published by then
new_features.err_band_14d_mw: same, over 14 days, restricted to hours whose forecast was in the same fixed size band (0/5/10/15/20 GW)
new_features.forecast_revision_24h_mw: forecast_mw minus the forecast for the same hour from the latest run published at least 24 h before the cutoff
new_features.forecast_day_max_mw, forecast_day_min_mw: shape of the decision-time forecast over delivery day D
new_features.day_of_week, bank_holiday: calendar of D (England & Wales bank holidays, published years ahead)
new_features.ndfd_demand_mw: Elexon NDFD national demand forecast for day D from the latest run published by the cutoff

preprocessing: imputation (median, with missing-value indicators), scaling and spline knots are fitted inside each training set only

regression.R2_random_forest: RandomForestRegressor(300 trees, min_samples_leaf=20, max_features=0.5, seed 42) on existing9 (production specification)
regression.R4_median_curve: QuantileRegressor(quantile=0.5, alpha=0) on the curve set
regression.R5_median_all: QuantileRegressor(quantile=0.5, alpha=0) on the all set
regression.R6_gbm_absolute: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=absolute_error, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=300, max_leaf_nodes=15, min_samples_leaf=40, l2_regularization=1.0, increasing in forecast_mw, seed 42) on the all set
regression.R7_median_curve_rolling_w30 / _w60 / _w9: R4 refitted for every decision day on the last W days of data known at its cutoff
regression.R8_ensemble_r5_r6: mean of the R5 and R6 corrected forecasts

classification.C2_random_forest: RandomForestClassifier(300 trees, min_samples_leaf=20, max_features=0.5, seed 42) on existing9 (production specification)
classification.C3_logistic_all: LogisticRegression(C=1) on the all set (imputed, scaled)
classification.C4_gbm_classifier: HistGradientBoostingClassifier(learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=300, max_leaf_nodes=15, min_samples_leaf=40, l2_regularization=1.0, increasing in forecast_mw, seed 42) on the all set
classification.C5_quantile_distribution: P(error >= 1000 MW) read from the predicted distribution of 9 HistGradientBoosting quantile models (q = 0.1 .. 0.9, same settings as R6) on the all set
classification.C6_logistic_curve_rolling_w30 / _w60 / _: LogisticRegression on the curve set refitted for every decision day on the last W days of data known at its cutoff

validation.scheme: rolling origin, one fold per delivery month 2025-04 .. 2025-12 (9 folds)
validation.static_models: fitted once per fold on deliveries up to 2 days before the fold's first day (all their labels are published before the fold's first cutoff)
validation.rolling_models: refitted for every validation delivery day d on deliveries in [d-1-W, d-2]
validation.hyper_parameters: fixed in this file; only W in {30, 60, 90} days varies, as separate candidates

selection.regression: lowest mean fold MAE of the corrected forecast
selection.classification: highest mean fold ROC-AUC; among candidates within 0.005 of the best, the lowest mean fold Brier score
selection.final_models: the selected candidates refitted on all development data (deliveries up to 31 Dec 2025); rolling candidates keep refitting only on data known at each cutoff

classifier_extras.calibration: Platt scaling fitted on the selected classifier's out-of-fold predictions; reported separately (it does not change ROC-AUC)
classifier_extras.thresholds: chosen on out-of-fold predictions only: (a) the highest threshold with recall >= 0.80; (b) the F1-maximising threshold

regression: MAE reduction vs the official forecast (%)
classification: precision, recall, F1 at 0.5 and at both thresholds

supplementary_evaluation.models: official forecast; production defaults (linear_by_level, logistic_by_level) and comparison models (random forests) exactly as saved; the v2 selected regressor and classifier as frozen at 31 Dec 2025 (a rolling candidate refits only on data published before each test cutoff)
supplementary_evaluation.sealing: predictions are written without labels and fingerprinted before any March-May label is scored
primary_comparisons: v2 selected regressor vs production linear_by_level: paired MAE difference
v2 selected classifier vs production logistic_by_level: ROC-AUC difference
supplementary_evaluation.uncertainty: 95% circular block bootstrap over whole days (3-day blocks, 5000 resamples); Diebold-Mariano test (HAC, 48 h) for the MAE difference
supplementary_evaluation.interpretation: an improvement is claimed only if its 95% interval excludes zero; otherwise the comparison is reported as inconclusive

adoption: No automatic integration. A v2 model may be proposed for the January application only if its supplementary gain is significant under the rule above, and only with the user's explicit approval.
leakage_controls: every feature is computed only from forecast, actual and demand-forecast rows published at or before the cutoff
perturbation tests: changing any value published after the cutoff leaves every feature unchanged, in GMT and on the BST clock-change day
preprocessing is fitted inside each training set only
training data ends at least 2 days before each validation delivery day
February 2026 is not used; January 2026 is context only; March-May 2026 data is downloaded only after this protocol is locked
supplementary predictions are sealed before labels are scored
